ideas.text: An AI that detects when a company's wellness program costs less per employee than one therapy session.
A bot that translates 'we care about your wellbeing' into what the company actually changed structurally to prove it.
An app that detects when a step challenge leaderboard is causing more stress than the stress it was designed to reduce.
A tool that calculates how many more emails you received this year than last year and calls it a burnout risk.
An AI that detects when a 'mental health day' policy requires you to disclose the reason and flags it for legal review.
A bot that converts 'self-care is your responsibility' into a list of structural things the company could fix instead.
An app that monitors when your PTO request will be subtly judged by your manager based on the timing.
A tool that detects when 'unlimited PTO' results in less vacation taken than the previous capped policy.
An AI that counts how many wellness initiatives were launched this year and checks how many underlying stressors were removed.
A bot that detects when a mindfulness app subscription is offered while headcount is being reduced and generates a comparison.
An app that audits whether employees feel safe enough to actually use the EAP benefits the company pays for.
A tool that detects when a company's burnout prevention webinar is scheduled during the busiest week of the quarter.
An AI that monitors your work hours and sends an automated message to your manager when you've been online for 11 hours.
A bot that detects when your 'no meeting Friday' was colonized by an all-hands and files a grievance.
An app that converts a wellness survey into a structured request for the one thing that would actually make a difference.
A tool that identifies which wellness perk is most used and funds more of it instead of guessing what employees need.
An AI that detects when a 'culture of balance' company expects responses within 2 hours after 6pm.
A bot that detects when the same employee has declined vacation 4 times for 'coverage reasons' and assigns backup.
An app that monitors your notification volume and recommends a communication cleanse before you need a real one.
A tool that detects when a company is discussing employee burnout in a meeting without having cancelled any meetings first.
An AI that detects when a 'meditation room' was installed in the same month as a 20% productivity target increase.
A bot that identifies which workplace stressors are mentioned most in exit interviews and have not been addressed.
An app that detects when a manager's check-in about your wellbeing is actually a check-in about your project status.
A tool that calculates how many hours of personal time you donated to the company this year in the form of unanswered-but-seen Slacks.
An AI that detects when 'resilience training' is being offered as a substitute for fixing the thing requiring resilience.
A bot that detects when you've been on a PIP and a wellness program at the same time and flags the contradiction.
An app that monitors all the wellness promises in your offer letter and checks which ones materialized.
A tool that estimates how much the company saved in healthcare costs from your unreported stress-related conditions.
An AI that detects when a 'work-life balance' company posts an Instagram about an employee working at midnight.
A bot that detects when a wellness benefit is designed for single people in their 20s at a company with mostly working parents.
An app that monitors when your workload has silently doubled since the last round of layoffs without a compensation adjustment.
A tool that converts every company-sponsored wellness workshop into the structural change that would have made it unnecessary.
An AI that detects when the wellness committee's biggest initiative this year is a step challenge during crunch month.
A bot that monitors your calendar density and sends a weekly mental load score so you can see the creep in real time.
An app that detects when 'we trust our people' is followed by a proximity badge access report sent to management.
A tool that detects when mandatory fun is happening during a week when morale is already negative.
An AI that identifies the specific meeting that is the source of 80% of your team's collective stress and cancels it.
A bot that detects when a mental health awareness email was sent by someone who rejected a flexible hours request last week.
An app that monitors whether the people attending your company's wellness events are the ones who need them most.
A tool that detects when a benefits package was last updated and compares it to current employee needs.
An AI that generates a real vacation auto-reply that sets realistic expectations instead of promising to catch up on Monday.
A bot that detects when a 'disconnecting over the holiday' email is immediately followed by a Slack from the same sender.
An app that monitors the number of consecutive days you've started work before 8am and sends a trend alert.
A tool that detects when a company is cutting the wellness budget and adding the word 'intentional' to its culture messaging.
An AI that calculates how much the company spent on office snacks versus mental health support per employee per year.
A bot that identifies which wellness initiatives are used by the same 12 people every time and designs something for everyone else.
An app that detects when your work schedule is structurally incompatible with any of the wellness habits being recommended.
A tool that generates a request for 1 additional day of PTO per quarter, supported by your overtime data.
An AI that detects when you sent a work email from a vacation location and sends you a disappointed notification.
A bot that detects when the company's annual wellness survey produced no visible action and tracks the year-over-year pattern.
An app that monitors whether the company's stated commitment to wellbeing is reflected in actual manager behavior.
An app that converts a company's wellness budget into the salary increase it could have funded instead.
A bot that detects when your company added a meditation cushion to the break room the same week deadlines doubled.
A tool that tracks when 'self-care' messaging increases in correlation with workload peaks.
An AI that detects when a company's burnout prevention webinar is run by someone who sends emails at midnight.
An app that converts every company wellness initiative into the structural fix that would have made it unnecessary.
A bot that detects when you've used 0 of your wellness benefit by November and spends it on your behalf.
